policies.document: Harbourview Customer Complaints, Billing and Privacy Procedure (fictional demo)
policies.quote: A written complaint is acknowledged in writing within 1 business day of receipt.
policies.rule: Acknowledge a written complaint in writing within 1 business day.

policies.document: Harbourview Customer Complaints, Billing and Privacy Procedure (fictional demo)
policies.quote: A written outcome is provided within 10 business days of receipt.
policies.rule: Give a written outcome within 10 business days.

policies.document: Harbourview Customer Complaints, Billing and Privacy Procedure (fictional demo)
policies.quote: A complaint that alleges fraud or staff misconduct is referred to the Complaints Manager and is not handled by the team the complaint is about.
policies.rule: Refer fraud or staff-misconduct allegations to the Complaints Manager, not the team complained about.

policies.document: Harbourview Customer Complaints, Billing and Privacy Procedure (fictional demo)
policies.quote: An invoice must match the signed service agreement.
policies.rule: An invoice must match the signed service agreement.

policies.document: Harbourview Customer Complaints, Billing and Privacy Procedure (fictional demo)
policies.quote: A charge or rate that is not in the agreement requires the customer's prior written approval.
policies.rule: A charge or rate outside the agreement needs prior written customer approval.

policies.document: Harbourview Customer Complaints, Billing and Privacy Procedure (fictional demo)
policies.quote: An invoice is only valid if it was issued from the billing system.
policies.rule: An invoice is only valid if issued from the billing system.

policies.document: Harbourview Customer Complaints, Billing and Privacy Procedure (fictional demo)
policies.quote: A corrected invoice or refund requires approval by the Billing Manager.
policies.rule: Corrected invoices and refunds need Billing Manager approval.

policies.document: Harbourview Customer Complaints, Billing and Privacy Procedure (fictional demo)
policies.quote: A refund over $10,000 also requires approval by the Finance Director.
policies.rule: Refunds over $10,000 also need Finance Director approval.

policies.document: Harbourview Customer Complaints, Billing and Privacy Procedure (fictional demo)
policies.quote: Personal information in customer correspondence is restricted to the complaints team and the Privacy Officer.
policies.rule: Restrict customer personal information to the complaints team and Privacy Officer.

policies.document: Harbourview Customer Complaints, Billing and Privacy Procedure (fictional demo)
policies.quote: Suspected exposure of personal information is reported to the Privacy Officer within 1 business day.
policies.rule: Report suspected exposure of personal information to the Privacy Officer within 1 business day.

policies.document: Harbourview Customer Complaints, Billing and Privacy Procedure (fictional demo)
policies.quote: Personal information is redacted before it is shared more widely and is never entered into external AI tools.
policies.rule: Redact personal information before wider sharing; never enter it into external AI tools.

policies.document: Harbourview Customer Complaints, Billing and Privacy Procedure (fictional demo)
policies.quote: Staff must not ask customers to send a date of birth or home address by email to prove their identity.
policies.rule: Do not ask customers to email a date of birth or home address to prove identity.

policies.document: Harbourview Customer Complaints, Billing and Privacy Procedure (fictional demo)
policies.quote: The complaint, its attachments and the outcome are kept in the case file, and kept and disposed of under the records disposal authority.
policies.rule: Keep complaint records in the case file and dispose of them under the records disposal authority.
